note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as shown on PlayStation Network (via Exophase / PSNProfiles, cross-checked by PlanetGTA6 on 2026-11-18). Guides are this entry's own words; every factual claim names its source.

trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then strangers, collectibles, activities, robberies and the 100% cleanup. The final piece is usually A Long Road, the 100% completion gold, so treat that as the real finish line.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first story mission, so this unlocks naturally at the start of the game — no preparation, no side work, and nothing you can miss. Hidden on PSN until earned because it names the opening mission.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and watch the chapter close. This is story progress only, so just keep playing the main missions in order. Before the chapter ends, do the meditation-spot work for Positive Mental Attitude — one Chapter 1 spot is reported to disappear afterwards, and there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Pure story progress: play the chapter's missions in order until the chapter closes and the trophy pops. Nothing here needs a guide beyond the missions themselves, and nothing in this chapter is reported missable.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep playing the main story in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. By this point the stranger strands and side activities are open too, but nothing in Chapter 3 gates the trophy — it is story completion only.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Story progress only — play the chapter through to its close. If you have been clearing stranger strands and collectibles along the way, the post-story cleanup will be shorter; if not, all of it can still be done after the story ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Play the final mission to its end. This is the story's last beat, so it unlocks by finishing the campaign — no side requirement. Before you start the finale, make a manual save: the guides agree the one potentially missable trophy sits in Chapter 1, not here, but a manual save before the ending is cheap insurance for anything the community is still confirming.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the main story, so just follow the mission markers in order. Hidden on PSN until earned because the mission name itself is a story spoiler.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. This is a main-story heist mission — play it through to the end and the trophy pops. Nothing to prepare in advance; the mission gives you what you need as it runs.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Main-story progress only — follow the mission through to its end. Hidden on PSN until earned, like the other named-mission trophies.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Main-story progress only — play the mission to its end. The mission name is a spoiler, which is why this trophy stays hidden on PSN until you earn it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Follow the main story to this mission and finish it. VCIA — the Vice City airport — also matters for Catch Me If You Can, so remember how the airport is laid out; the two trophies are separate, and this one is just the mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Main-story progress only — play it through to the end. The name suggests a big set-piece mission; approach it like any story mission, with the gear and health the game hands you along the way.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own checklist. Rockstar has not published what the 100% list contains, so do not trust any checklist that claims to know it exactly — the guides agree only that the visible trophies sketch the workload: story, strangers, collectibles, activities, robberies and exploration. Work through this guide's roadmap stage by stage; when the in-game completion counter reads 100%, this gold pops. It is worth 100 Gamerscore on Xbox, the biggest single achievement there.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, flips, near-misses and other driving feats the game counts as a stunt. The count is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so you will build it up naturally by driving fast and messily; if you are short at the end, chain jumps off ramps and hills in free roam and let the counter climb. PlayStation tracks the total for you, so check your progress there before grinding.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type in the game at least once — the count the starter data carries is 9 types. Work down the activities list in this guide: races, drone races, fishing, arcade games, shooting range, stunts, meditation, bowling and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish them all here, just sample each type.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Go to a shooting range, pick a challenge, and beat its gold time or score — repeat until every challenge shows gold. This is a skill grind, not a luck one: learn each challenge's layout, then run it clean. Leave it for the post-story cleanup, when you can practise without story pressure.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Find each race start, learn the course, and win — one win per location counts. The drone handles differently from a car, so expect a few practice runs per course before the win sticks.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race list across Leonida, one win per event, and keep a note of which you have won so you do not repeat one by mistake. Any race type counts as long as it is a new event you have not won before.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing is one of the game's activities: find a fishing spot, take the challenge, and out-fish Cal. If you lose the first attempt, retry — the challenge stays available, and losing costs nothing but the attempt.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play an arcade game to completion. Find an arcade machine in the world, start a game, and finish it — one full playthrough of any arcade game is enough. This is one of the quickest trophies in the set, and a good first step toward Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand, all the way to his final mission. Stranger strands open as you explore Leonida — meet Andy, keep taking his missions when they appear, and the strand ends with this trophy. Hidden on PSN until earned because it names a character's story arc.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, through to his final mission. Meet Kenton out in the world, follow his strand mission by mission, and the trophy pops at the end. Stranger strands are part of the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks, so this counts toward that silver too.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand, through to his final mission. Keep returning to Billy's missions as they unlock across the map; the strand ends with this trophy. Like the other stranger finals, it is hidden on PSN until earned.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands. Strangers appear across Leonida as you explore — each one has a chain of missions, and finishing a chain counts as one strand. The five named finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight; find three more strangers and finish their chains too. This is a slow-burn trophy: meet strangers whenever you spot them and the count builds up.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand, through to his final mission. Meet Randy, work his missions as they appear, and the strand ends with this trophy. It counts as one of the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand, through to his final mission. Follow Tyrone's missions to the end of his chain. Five named stranger finals plus three more strands make the 8 for Strangers & Freaks — this is one of the five.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the guides agree one spot — Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1 — is reported to disappear after Chapter 1, and with no mission replay and no New Game+, a missed spot may mean a new playthrough. Do this in Chapter 1, before the chapter closes, and keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until the trophy pops. The exact missable status is still unconfirmed by the community — PlanetGTA6 notes there is no reliable missable list yet — so treat the Chapter 1 save as insurance, not as a proven fact.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret is one of the strangers — meet him, take the hunt, and track the animal he names. Hunting is a world activity: follow the animal's trail, take the shot cleanly, and bring the result back to Bret. Hidden on PSN until earned because it names a stranger's quest.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — find them, collect full sets, and three completed sets earn the silver. Track which sets you have finished so you do not chase cards from a set you already completed; the in-game collection view shows your progress per set.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game camera/social feature — open it at a location, take the shot, and the location counts. Work through Leonida's landmarks and districts one by one; the counter is cumulative, so every location you WAiNK at stays counted. This pairs naturally with The Goodtime State, since both reward covering the map.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's scattered mini-goals — driving, combat, exploration and more — and they stack up across the whole playthrough. Play broadly rather than grinding one type: sample every activity and the challenge count climbs on its own. Check the in-game challenge list to see which categories you have barely touched.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. You need your partner in the vehicle or on foot with you when the heat comes off — a solo escape does not count. Cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars, then break line of sight, hide, and wait for the wanted level to clear while your partner is still with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between robberies. Plan a route past three shops, hit them one after another, and keep moving so the wanted level never clears. If the heat drops, the chain breaks and you start again.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Just getting into a new vehicle type counts as discovering it, so drive everything you see — cars, bikes, boats, planes and anything else with wheels or wings. The counter is cumulative and never resets, so a curious playthrough that tries every vehicle will finish this without a dedicated grind.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a crowd of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five of them before the focus ends. Pick a busy firefight — story missions with groups of enemies are the easiest place to line this up — and aim for quick, clean takedowns rather than one long duel.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — the trophy's wording points at taking off without a ticket or a flight plan. Get to VCIA, find a plane, and get airborne on your own terms. Hidden on PSN until earned, which suggests the exact method is a small surprise — experiment at the airport and the trophy will tell you when you have done it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks — the trophy's description is a joke about how hot it gets inside one. Get into a Rhino, or take one on, and the trophy follows from the encounter. Hidden on PSN until earned; the game will show you what counts when you meet a Rhino in the world.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away without ever being detected. Go in quiet, stay out of sight lines and cameras, take the goods, and leave clean — any detection fails the attempt. Plan the approach before you walk in, and if you are spotted, leave and try again; the trophy only counts a fully undetected run.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vault robberies are the big jobs: plan the entry, crack the vault, and get clear with the heat on you. Five completed vault jobs earn the silver — they do not need to be back-to-back, so take them one at a time between other work and let the count build.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it, take the cash, and get away clean. Armored trucks travel with guards and draw police fast, so hit hard, grab the money, and break away before the response builds up.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The count the starter data carries is 52 areas — visit every district, town and corner of the map until the exploration counter is full. This pairs with You WAiNKer! and Whip It Good: drive everywhere, WAiNK at the landmarks, and the map fills itself in. Check the in-game map for areas you have not set foot in yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Find each gang's operation, hit it, and move on to the next gang — nine gangs, nine robberies. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit so you do not repeat one; the count only moves on a new gang's operation.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach waterfront, find a bar or a spot where you can order a drink, and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment trophy — no combat, no timer, just the beach. Hidden on PSN until earned.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle out through a showroom — smash the glass and take it to the street in classic GTA style. Pick a vehicle showroom, get in a car inside it, and drive straight out through the front. Hidden on PSN until earned; the showroom will make the moment obvious when you are in it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on the throw. Find the alley, pick up a game, and complete a proper bowling throw. It is one of the game's quiet activities — a good breather between story missions, and it also counts toward trying every activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, and the guides do not pin down the exact trigger. It sits with the story-adjacent world moments, so play the story and the duo's shared activities and it should unlock as the partnership grows. If it has not popped by the post-story cleanup, revisit the duo activities and the story's relationship beats.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — PlayStation tracks a count that runs to 500. The choices are the small decisions scattered through missions and the world: dialogue picks, approach choices, and the way you handle encounters. Play naturally and the count climbs; there is no single choice that earns this, it is the total. Hidden on PSN until earned.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something — the description reads like a trophy for retrying and winning. If a mission, challenge or activity beats you once, go straight back in and finish it; the trophy rewards the comeback. Hidden on PSN until earned, and the exact trigger is not spelled out in the guides, so treat a clean second-try success as the way in.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida — the description is a reaction, not an instruction, and the guides do not name the exact event. It sits with the world's odd moments: explore off the beaten path, poke at the strange corners of the map, and keep an eye out for something that does not belong. Hidden on PSN until earned.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. Get a vehicle moving, lean out with a melee weapon, and connect. It takes timing more than force: pick a slow stretch of road, line up a pedestrian, and swing as you pass. Hidden on PSN until earned.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — they are dirty money until you wash them through the contacts who handle that work. Keep laundering after every big job and the total climbs toward $250,000; it is cumulative, so every bill you wash counts. The money side of the game feeds this directly, so it finishes naturally if you keep robbing and laundering.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all the shops in Leonida. Buy cars, clothes, weapons, food and gear — every dollar spent in a shop counts toward the total, and it is cumulative across the whole game. If you are short at the end, buy an expensive vehicle or a stack of gear; big-ticket purchases close the gap fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are the property purchases that store your vehicles — find each one for sale, pay the price, and the count moves. Eight garages, eight purchases; the money comes from the robberies and laundering that feed the rest of this stage. Check the property listings on the in-game map for any garage you have not bought yet.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles out in the world, take them to the app's registration flow, and log them — ten registered vehicles earns the trophy. It pairs with Whip It Good, since both reward collecting vehicles; register the interesting ones as you discover them and the two trophies climb together.
trophies.name: On the Spot
